<subject>Re: Lumière Santé, Lyon Patient Database</subject>
<body>
Bernard,

We've completed a review this morning to try to fill in missing pieces of information on patient admission patterns, surgical scheduling history, and referral records for Lyon and have not come up with anything yet. Would you know of any of the above information which would assist us in our efforts?

Thanks,

Eugène Leconte
</body>
<quoted>
----- Original Message -----
From: Adrien Thibault
To: Bernard Schmitt
Cc: Édouard Pruvost ; Aimé Ruiz ; Honoré Allard
Sent: Wednesday, January 8, 2025 6:20 PM
Subject: Lumière Santé, Lyon Patient Database

Bernard,

Below, I have summarized HealthCare Analytics Plus's work on the Lyon database to date. The "Inter_Regional_Departments" file shows the topology and links between clinical units in our model and "Expand_Capacity_Data_011000.xls" details the existing facility information that we have compiled to date. Total bed capacity closely matches reported capacity as shown in "L&R_0110.xls". Reported Lyon total in 2023 is 1,240 beds and that in the HealthCare Analytics Plus database is 1,207 beds through 2023.
